import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Connect to the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Create an embedding index on the "content" column using the
# sentence-transformers UDF pixeltable ships, with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model
t.add_embedding_index(
    column="content",
    string_embed=sentence_transformer.using(model_id="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"),
)

# Build a similarity expression against the query string
sim = t.content.similarity("climate change policy")

# Retrieve the 5 closest rows, ranked from closest to farthest
results = (
    t.order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .select(t.content, similarity=sim)
    .collect()
)

print(results)

import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Connect to the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Create an embedding index on the "content" column using the
# sentence-transformers UDF pixeltable ships, with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model
t.add_embedding_index(
    column="content",
    string_embed=sentence_transformer.using(model_id="all-MiniLM-L6-v2"),
)

# Build a similarity expression against the query string
sim = t.content.similarity("climate change policy")

# Retrieve the 5 closest rows, ranked from closest to farthest
results = (
    t.order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .select(t.content, similarity=sim)
    .collect()
)

print(results)
